name: markdown import every block type
why: A heading ends at its line; following paragraph lines join with a space; '- [x]' is a checked to-do; two spaces of indent are one level; '3)' is a numbered item (the number is not kept); '***' is a divider; ' ' is an empty paragraph; consecutive '>' lines form one quote ('>' alone is an empty line); '|' starts a table. Export writes the canonical form: blank lines between blocks except between list items, lists renumbered from 1, '---' for dividers.

Para one
continued

- [x] done
  - nested

```rust
fn main() {}
```
